subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should `supportsReasoningEffort`, `supportedReasoningEfforts`, and `reasoningEffortMap` be accepted as the durable OpenAI Responses provider-configuration contract, including `models.json` persistence?
rationale: The implementation promotes these fields across shared public types, runtime registry validation, capability calculation, and request serialization; that cross-surface provider contract needs an owner decision even if related config documentation already exists.

options.title: Adopt the shared compatibility contract
options.body: Approve the Responses contract, require exact-head request proof and a current-main merge refresh, then review the resulting merge candidate.

options.title: Keep Responses configuration narrower
options.body: Decline the Responses registry/type expansion and retain only the already-supported transport or model-specific behavior until a dedicated provider-contract proposal is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared compatibility contract
recommendation.body: Approve the Responses contract, require exact-head request proof and a current-main merge refresh, then review the resulting merge candidate.
